question: Does the controlled real-Velvia-versus-digital-Velvia neutral ramp support a held-patch monotone tone residual beyond identity, one gamma and one affine line?

observation.input_role: digital Velvia/Vivid publication-thumbnail neutral-patch D65 L-star
observation.target_role: real Velvia 50 E-6/V850 publication-thumbnail neutral-patch D65 L-star
observation.claim_limit: display-chain tone observation; scanner and publication rendering remain inseparable

models.gamma: 100 times (L-in divided by 100) to one positive least-squares exponent
models.affine: one unconstrained least-squares slope and intercept, evaluated before clipping
models.monotone_pchip: PCHIP through development observations plus fixed black (0,0) and white (100,100) anchors

selection_rule: retain the fixed monotone tone residual for one separately frozen photo stress only if every gate passes; otherwise close without changing anchors, knots, thresholds or model family
claim_ceiling: development evidence on six neutral patches from one controlled publication display-chain comparison; not a scene exposure curve, characteristic curve, scanner-independent Velvia response, calibrated stock tone, photo transfer or product promotion
